artboards.title: 1 · Visit · a match in the bag

annotations.text: Shipped visit, one line added: the bubble says whether Maple's pig will swap or is gift only. The strip lifts the match as today; the head line now says tap it to SWAP.

Tap the lifted find → the offer tray rises over the strip, carrying the find you're giving. Three finds the server chose from Maple's bag (largest stacks first, frozen per wish — never a count, never the whole bag). Tap one → the swap. The link at the bottom is the gift.
Options empty: the host's bag has nothing to spare. One honest line and the one button. The bubble already said gift only, so this is never a surprise.

The receipt, in the delivery's dialog: a kicker says swapped, both finds, the host's gain first, the tickles second. Host and guest pigs happy; both tallies +3; the bubble below already reads next time.
A gift's receipt: one find, the same title, plus the generous tick. This is exactly today's delivery receipt with one clause added.
Back on the visit: the strip is quiet, the old key sits in the bag with a small from-a-friend mark, the bubble shows the pig's next wish under next time. Nothing lifts — one swap per pair per day.

Same day, second visit: the bubble names the new wish and says you two swapped today; every tile at rest; the strip says come back tomorrow. The server's already_today gate, drawn as a state, never a refusal toast.

Arriving at a napping barn with a match: the nap card gains Swap under Head home (only when the wish is open, not swapped today, and the bag holds it). Tapping it folds the card; the host keeps napping; the tray works as usual.
Flow notes: the tray, gift only, the receipt, after and the next day, the nap card, and what each server answer does on screen. Read with Part 2 §2/§5/§12 of the plan.
